basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent graduate who just moved to Davis for a new job in environmental science. In my free time, I love exploring new hobbies like archery, which is why I'm on the lookout for local ranges. Besides that, I enjoy solving quizzes on Sporcle and hunting for the best deals on games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, typically between 8 PM and 11 PM. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore new interests and communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My background is in environmental science, with a focus on ecology and conservation. I completed my degree at a state university where I also picked up an interest in archery through a campus club. Most of my knowledge comes from academic studies and self-teaching through online resources.
